versions.changelog:
astroph-arxiv-skill v0.1.5

- Updated documentation in SKILL.md and README.md for clarity and accuracy.
- Removed obsolete file: skill-card.md.
- SKILL.md: Streamlined Python fetch/parse example (removed highlight formatting).
- Description updated to reflect embedded Python script for robust XML parsing.

## astroph-arxiv-skill version 0.1.4 changelog

- Documentation updated; SKILL.md was not changed—only README.md was edited.
- No code, logic, or feature changes in the skill itself.

- Integrated a Python script directly into the skill for improved and reproducible XML parsing of arXiv results.
- Updated the workflow to fetch, parse, and format data using Python rather than bash, ensuring accurate highlighting and strict adherence to the required academic output format.
- Clarified handling of arXiv API quirks, requiring use of subcategories for recent papers.
- Removed legacy documentation (skill-card.md) and updated instructions in documentation files.

## astroph-arxiv-skill 0.1.2 Changelog

- Updated README.md with no changes to SKILL.md or core logic.
- No new features or logic changes in this version.

- Updated version from 1.1.0 to 1.2.0 in SKILL.md.
- Added a new README.md file to the repository.
- No changes to skill capabilities or core logic.

- Renamed skill to "astroph-radar" and updated version to 1.1.0.
- Now targets only the astro-ph category on arXiv with options for astro-ph.GA (galactic structures).
- Strict default: returns a maximum of 2 papers unless user requests otherwise.
- Extracts and presents full, unedited abstracts in blockquote format.
- Auto-bolds references to catalogs, surveys, instruments, and key methodologies in abstracts.
- Outputs in structured academic format with title, authors, date, and both arXiv and PDF links.
